sample_ids <- as.character(expr[1, -1])

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr[-1, -1])
storage.mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"
rownames(expr_mat) <- gene_ids
colnames(expr_mat) <- sample_ids

# Read differential analysis

g2_samples <- c("CohortBctrl1", "CohortBctrl2", "CohortBctrl4", "CohortBsi1", "CohortBsi2", "CohortBsi3")

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
# Load differential analysis
xlsx_file <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
diff_df <- read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = 1) %>% as.data.frame()
cat("Total genes:", nrow(diff_df), "\n")
# Significance thresholds
fc_cut <- 1
p_cut  <- 0.05
# Add -log10(p) and classification
diff_df$negLog10P <- -log10(diff_df$pvalue)
diff_df$Status <- "NS"
diff_df$Status[diff_df$pvalue < p_cut & diff_df$log2FoldChange >  fc_cut] <- "Up"
diff_df$Status[diff_df$pvalue < p_cut & diff_df$log2FoldChange < -fc_cut] <- "Down"
diff_df$Status <- factor(diff_df$Status, levels = c("Down", "NS", "Up"))

# Top up & down genes by significance

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
# Load differential analysis
xlsx_file <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
diff_df <- read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = 1) %>% as.data.frame()
# Significance thresholds
fc_cut <- 1
p_cut  <- 0.05
diff_df$negLog10P <- -log10(diff_df$pvalue)
diff_df$Status <- "NS"
diff_df$Status[diff_df$pvalue < p_cut & diff_df$log2FoldChange >  fc_cut] <- "Up"
diff_df$Status[diff_df$pvalue < p_cut & diff_df$log2FoldChange < -fc_cut] <- "Down"
diff_df$Status <- factor(diff_df$Status, levels = c("Down", "NS", "Up"))
# Cap -log10(p) at finite value (some p = 0 -> Inf)
max_p <- max(diff_df$negLog10P[is.finite(diff_df$negLog10P)])
diff_df$negLog10P[diff_df$negLog10P > max_p] <- max_p
# Top labeled genes
top_up <- diff_df %>% filter(Status == "Up") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% head(10)
top_down <- diff_df %>% filter(Status == "Down") %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% head(10)
labeled <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)
# Cap x-axis to a reasonable range for visualization
xlim_max <- max(c(abs(diff_df$log2FoldChange[is.finite(diff_df$log2FoldChange)]), fc_cut + 1))
xlim_max <- ceiling(xlim_max / 2) * 2
cat("xlim_max =", xlim_max, "\n")
cat("ymax =", max(diff_df$negLog10P), "\n")
# Build the diagonal volcano plot (a rotated volcano: -log10(p) vs log2FC with diagonal lines)
p <- ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = negLog10P, color = Status)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_df, Status == "NS"),
             color = "grey70", alpha = 0.55, size = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_df, Status != "NS"),
             aes(color = Status), alpha = 0.85, size = 1.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Down" = "#2c7fb8", "NS" = "grey70", "Up" = "#d7301f")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  # diagonal trend line (rotated 45° effect) representing log10(p) ~ -|log2FC|
  geom_abline(slope = -1 / (xlim_max / max_p), intercept = max_p,
              linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = labeled,
                  aes(label = id),
                  size = 3, max.overlaps = 25, box.padding = 0.35,
                  segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.25) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-xlim_max, xlim_max),
                     breaks = seq(-xlim_max, xlim_max, by = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot",
       subtitle = paste0("Group2 vs Group1  |  |log2FC| > ", fc_cut,
                         " & p < ", p_cut),
       x = expression(log[2]*" Fold Change"),
       y = expression(-log[10]*"("*italic(p)*"-value)"),
       color = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
        legend.position = "top")
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: diagonal_volcano.png\n")
# Also save the result table for inspection
write.csv(diff_df, "volcano_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: volcano_data.csv\n")
